name: Off-Road Motorcycle
description: A motorcycle manufactured for and used exclusively off roads, highways and other paved surfaces, such as an off-road e-moto.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle manufactured for and used exclusively off roads, highways and other paved surfaces (47 O.S. §1102)

Registered once with Service Oklahoma within 30 days of purchase, with no yearly registration fee; optional for one bought before July 1, 2005, or owned under an agricultural exemption (47 O.S. §1115.3)
Titled when bought or transferred on or after July 1, 2005 (47 O.S. §1105)
Exempt from the motorcycle equipment rules (mirrors, windshield or eyewear, speedometer, fenders, horn) on trail rides off public roads
Riders and passengers under 18 must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218
